metadata.name: NourishGraph Golden Dataset
metadata.description: 100 test cases for evaluating NourishGraph system
metadata.author: Bárbara Peres

test_cases.input: What is the nutritional information for 100g of grilled chicken breast?
test_cases.expected_output: Contains approximately: 165 kcal, 31g protein, 0g carbohydrates, 3.6g fat

test_cases.input: Which has more protein: egg or tofu?
test_cases.expected_output: Egg has ~13g protein/100g, tofu has ~8g/100g. Egg has more protein.

test_cases.input: How many calories are in a plate of rice with beans and steak?
test_cases.expected_output: Approximately 500-600 kcal depending on portions...

test_cases.input: How much protein is in salmon?
test_cases.expected_output: Salmon contains approximately 20-25g of protein per 100g

test_cases.input: What are the macros in an avocado?
test_cases.expected_output: Avocado (100g): ~160 kcal, 2g protein, 9g carbs, 15g fat (mostly healthy fats)

test_cases.input: Which foods are high in fiber?
test_cases.expected_output: High-fiber foods include: legumes, whole grains, vegetables, fruits, nuts

test_cases.input: What foods are rich in vitamin D?
test_cases.expected_output: Vitamin D sources: fatty fish, egg yolks, fortified foods, mushrooms exposed to UV

test_cases.input: How many calories should I eat to lose weight?
test_cases.expected_output: Weight loss typically requires a caloric deficit of 500-750 kcal/day from your TDEE

test_cases.input: How much water should I drink per day?
test_cases.expected_output: Generally 2-3 liters per day, varies by activity level, climate, and body weight

test_cases.input: How much sugar is too much?
test_cases.expected_output: WHO recommends less than 25g (6 teaspoons) of added sugar per day

test_cases.input: How much protein do I need for muscle building?
test_cases.expected_output: For muscle building: 1.6-2.2g protein per kg body weight per day

test_cases.input: Are carbohydrates bad for you?
test_cases.expected_output: Carbohydrates are not inherently bad; complex carbs from whole foods are beneficial

test_cases.input: What are good sources of iron?
test_cases.expected_output: Iron sources: red meat, spinach, legumes, fortified cereals, organ meats

test_cases.input: What are the benefits of omega-3 fatty acids?
test_cases.expected_output: Omega-3 benefits: heart health, brain function, anti-inflammatory properties

test_cases.input: What is a healthy portion size for pasta?
test_cases.expected_output: A healthy pasta portion is about 80-100g dry weight (200-250g cooked)

test_cases.input: What is a healthy breakfast?
test_cases.expected_output: Healthy breakfast: protein (eggs, yogurt), complex carbs (oats), fruits, healthy fats

test_cases.input: What are healthy snack options?
test_cases.expected_output: Healthy snacks: nuts, fruits, yogurt, vegetables with hummus, cheese

test_cases.input: How can vegetarians get enough protein?
test_cases.expected_output: Vegetarian protein sources: legumes, tofu, tempeh, eggs, dairy, quinoa, nuts

test_cases.input: How much sodium should I consume daily?
test_cases.expected_output: Recommended sodium: less than 2300mg/day, ideally 1500mg for most adults

test_cases.input: What are the best calcium sources besides milk?
test_cases.expected_output: Non-dairy calcium: leafy greens, fortified plant milks, sardines, almonds, tofu
